# SeamlessFlow

> SeamlessFlow (seamlessflow.ai) is a done-for-you short-form video and ads agency based in New York City. We plan, script, film, edit and post short videos on Instagram, Facebook, TikTok and YouTube, then run paid ads on the videos that already perform. We mostly work with service businesses like roofers, HVAC companies, plumbers, electricians, remodelers, junk removal companies, movers and landscapers. NYC based, available to travel.

## How it works
- Once, at the start: discovery call, full brand audit (Google Business Profile, Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, YouTube, website), brand roadmap.
- Every month: content plan, scripts and shot list, shoot day at the client's business or job sites, editing, posting, analytics, ads on proven content.
- The client approves every video before it goes live (2 business days to review).
- Results in as little as 30, 15, or 10 days depending on the package. "Results" means first videos live and real numbers coming in. We don't guarantee views, followers or sales.

## Packages (monthly, per location)
All packages are short-form video, 30 seconds to 2 minutes each.
- Launch: from $3,000/mo. 8 short-form videos a month, half-day shoot, scripts, story topics, posting, boosts on top videos, monthly report. 3-month minimum.
- Growth: from $4,500/mo. 12 short-form videos a month, full-day shoot, weekly story topics, an outline for one live a month, comment and DM replies using approved answers, ad campaigns on top videos, report every two weeks. 3-month minimum.
- Full Service: from $8,000/mo. 20+ short-form videos a month, two shoot days, full scripts for stories and lives, ads on Instagram, Facebook, TikTok and YouTube, Google SEO and Business Profile, weekly report and strategy call. 6-month minimum.
- Final price is set after the audit, based on market, locations and shoot volume. One-time onboarding fee set by the audit. Ad spend is paid directly to the platforms, never marked up. After the minimum term, month to month with 30 days' notice.
- Long-form and YouTube watch-time content is priced separately.

## Add-ons
Google SEO and Business Profile (included in Full Service), lead follow-up automation (missed-call text back, automatic follow-ups), AI chat assistant for the client's website, website builds.
